name: @arena/marketplace-ui
description: The reusable view model for Arena marketplace surfaces (Work Order B013; issue #88): pure, deterministic, frozen-data-driven projections of expert-service and artifact listings — identity, the provenance summary under the evidence truth class, the rights posture, the verification status under its own truth class, certification presence ONLY when a certification record backs it (composition-scoped: Body Version × Substrate × Environment × Runtime × Suite — a marketplace purchase is never a certification), and the explicit entitlement state machine (granted / revoked / expired / pending, read from the append-only grant record lineage, never implied by ownership). Zero runtime dependencies: the package projects canonical marketplace objects structurally through honest readers (a missing or foreign-typed field degrades to unknown, never a guess) — a projection, never a second domain model, with no client-side price or entitlement logic.
